serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
Bot: Oh wow! Melissa, you look amazing!
#Annalie_Outside.face.pervy
Lady Annalie: I know, right?~ It took some time, but I finally found the perfect outfit for Melissa! 
Melissa: Took some time? You were keeping me hostage for hours.
#Annalie_Outside.Eyes.Sad+Annalie_Outside.Mouth.Awww
Lady Annalie: Don’t be a child, women need to invest in their beauty.
#Annalie_Outside.face.normal
Lady Annalie: And what do you think, Anon? Do you like Melissa’s new style?
You: It’s great. {{wi}}Maybe a little too Annalie-like.
#Annalie_Outside.Eyes.Sad+Annalie_Outside.Mouth.Awww
Lady Annalie: Was that your attempt at comedy? If it was, it failed miserably!
You: Don’t take it so personally, jeez…
#Annalie_Outside.face.normal
Lady Annalie: Don’t listen to him Melissa, you look totally like yourself in this. {{Wi}}With few improvements.
Bot: Yeah! You look like Melissa, but cooler!
#Cashier.Eyes.closed+Cashier.Mouth.open
Melissa: I understand that you both are trying to compliment me, but I really liked my Chinese dress, you know? Go easy on her.
#Cashier.Face.normal
Lady Annalie: I will do that, but only because it’s you who is asking. Usually I’m merciless towards fashion criminals. 
Criminals? Too soon, Annalie. Too soon… {{wi}}I swear, this girl has no awareness whatsoever. Don’t you remember what happened the last time we all met together?
Now that I think about it, Melissa had to deal with Annalie’s harassment for quite some time… {{wI}}I hope she’s not too bothered about it, but now that I know her past, I’m kind of worried…
What if Annalie’s behavior is triggering bad memories?
I need to intervene…
You: Hey, Melissa. Could we talk for a second? Just the two of us?
Melissa: Sure.
#Annalie_Outside.face.pervy
Lady Annalie: Ho~ What’s going on? 
#Annalie_Outside.face.suprised
You: Could you give us some space? We have some unfinished business.
#Annalie_Outside.Eyes.Suprised+Annalie_Outside.Mouth.Hmm
Lady Annalie: S-Sure…
